title: 宠物友好酒店筛选
prompt: 想找一家适合带宠物入住的酒店，让我填写宠物种类、体重、入住日期和目的地，筛选符合条件的住宿。
program:
root = Col([intro, tool, note])

$petType = ""
$weight = 0
$checkIn = ""
$destination = ""
$submitted = false

intro = Text("这是一个宠物友好住宿筛选器。请填写宠物种类、体重、入住日期和目的地，点击「筛选住宿」后会按静态示例数据筛选。所有住宿均为虚构演示，不提供实时房态或预订。", "sm", "muted")

note = Text("本页面仅使用本地状态完成筛选，不会调用模型，也不会创建订单。", "xs", "faint")

petOptions = ["猫", "狗", "兔", "鸟", "其他"]

weightNum = @Default($weight, 0)
destClean = @Trim($destination)

valid = $petType != "" && weightNum > 0 && $checkIn != "" && destClean != ""

petError = $submitted && $petType == "" ? "请选择宠物种类" : null
weightError = $submitted && weightNum <= 0 ? "请输入大于 0 的体重（kg）" : null
dateError = $submitted && $checkIn == "" ? "请选择入住日期" : null
destError = $submitted && destClean == "" ? "请输入目的地" : null

invalidMsg = $submitted && !valid ? Text("请补全所有必填项，并确保体重有效。", "sm", "danger") : null

demoHotels = [
  {name: "爪爪友好酒店", destination: "杭州", area: "西湖区", pets: "猫,狗", maxWeight: 12},
  {name: "毛孩子度假屋", destination: "上海", area: "崇明", pets: "猫,狗,兔", maxWeight: 15},
  {name: "飞盘驿站", destination: "杭州", area: "余杭", pets: "狗", maxWeight: 25},
  {name: "猫咪庭院", destination: "苏州", area: "姑苏", pets: "猫", maxWeight: 6},
  {name: "山海宠物民宿", destination: "青岛", area: "崂山", pets: "狗,兔", maxWeight: 10}
]

matches = valid ? @Filter(@Filter(@Filter(demoHotels, "destination", "contains", destClean), "pets", "contains", $petType), "maxWeight", ">=", weightNum) : []

resultCards = @Each(matches, "h", TravelItem(
  h.name,
  h.destination + " · " + h.area + " · 可携带 " + h.pets,
  [],
  [Badge("体重上限 " + h.maxWeight + " kg", "purple"), Badge("虚构演示", "purple")]
))

filterSummary = Col([
  Text("筛选条件：目的地 " + destClean + " · " + $petType + " · 宠物体重 " + weightNum + " kg · 入住 " + $checkIn, "sm", "ink", "medium"),
  Caption("未查询 " + $checkIn + " 当日实时房态，仅按静态条件筛选。")
], 1)

resultCount = Text("找到 " + @Count(matches) + " 家符合条件（虚构数据）", "sm", "ink", "medium")
noResult = Text("当前示例中没有符合条件的住宿。请保留宠物的真实种类和体重，可尝试其他目的地；演示目的地包括杭州、上海、苏州和青岛。", "sm", "warning")

results = $submitted && valid ? Col([
  filterSummary,
  @Count(matches) > 0 ? resultCount : null,
  @Count(matches) > 0 ? Col(resultCards, 2) : noResult
], 2) : null

tool = TravelModule([
  Badge("数据为虚构演示", "purple"),
  FieldRow("宠物种类", [Select($petType, petOptions, "宠物种类", "请选择")], "示例数据按所选宠物匹配", petError),
  FieldRow("体重（kg）", [Input($weight, "体重（kg）", "number", "例如 8")], "需大于 0", weightError),
  FieldRow("入住日期", [DatePicker($checkIn, "入住日期", @Today())], "仅用于汇总，不查实时房态", dateError),
  FieldRow("目的地", [Input($destination, "目的地", "text", "例如 杭州")], "支持包含匹配", destError),
  Row([Button("筛选住宿", @Set($submitted, true), "solid", null, null, "search"), Button("填入示例", Action([@Set($petType, "狗"), @Set($weight, 8), @Set($checkIn, @AddDays(@Today(), 7)), @Set($destination, "杭州"), @Set($submitted, false)]), "ghost"), Button("清空", @Reset($petType, $weight, $checkIn, $destination, $submitted), "ghost")], 2),
  invalidMsg,
  results
], "form", "宠物友好住宿筛选", "输入条件后点「筛选住宿」；所有住宿均为虚构演示。")
